LibreLookAI needs unrestricted background processing to safely import photos, remove backgrounds, and tag your clothes with AI.

Without this permission, Android may kill the app mid-process, which can lead to data loss — partially imported items, missing tags, or corrupted files.

LibreLookAI is a free, open-source AI-powered wardrobe manager. It helps you organize your clothing, get outfit suggestions, plan travel packing lists, and discover wardrobe gaps — all powered by AI.
This app is open source and free to use. The source code is available on GitHub.
LibreLookAI relies heavily on Google Gemini for vision and text AI. Every AI action (background removal, tagging, outfit suggestions, etc.) requires a Gemini API call, which has a small cost.
Travel packing list / wardrobe gap analysis: 2 credits

You can use your own free Gemini API key to avoid credit costs entirely:

1. Go to aistudio.google.com
2. Click "Get API key" → "Create API key"
3. Copy the key (starts with AIza…)
4. Paste it in Settings → Profile → Gemini API Key

Your key is stored only on this device and used directly with Google — no data passes through our servers.

For users who prefer not to create their own API key, the app offers a coin-based credit system. Credits can be purchased in the Credits tab and are consumed per AI action at the rates listed above. This mode routes requests through a server-side proxy.
